dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
I have made my move.
我落子了。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
... Oh, so you have.
……哦。这一着。

An old man garbed in a glistening white dopo robe sat opposite the child, who wore a hat woven from horsehair and bamboo.
头戴黑笠的孩子与身披泛着光泽的白色长袍的老人相对而坐。

The furnace was dark and unlit; the room was freezing. The two sat without even lighting a candle, the moonlight their only source of illumination.
火炉中漆黑一片，房间十分阴冷。甚至灯也没有点上，只有拉门敞开。

Yet the moon was fully waxed and bright...
但，那满月的光辉如玉壶般明净……

... bright enough to cast its cold light upon the black and white stones on the board.
因此两人之间，黑白棋子置于棋盘上的情形依然清晰可见。

The Left State Councilor and his bodyguard were having a silent discussion via the game of baduk.
左议政与他的护卫武士，正借这次对弈进行着隐晦的谈话。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Apologies, young man. I was absorbed in thought.
对不住。老夫在思考别的事情。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
It is quite all right. We have not set a time limit for this game.
没关系。这次对局并不计时。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Ha ha ha.
哈哈哈。

The old man gently chuckled.
老人慈祥地笑着。

He sat there for a moment, toying with the black stones in the bowl.
随后一言不发，拨弄着棋罐内的黑子。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
Mind me not, Left State Councilor. I am but a student in this match. It would be unbecoming of me to bid you hurry.
不必在意。作为此场棋局受教之人，我不会因此而催促您。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Yet you are quite impatient now, no?
话虽如此，你看上去可是一副焦躁的样子哦？

Clack.
嗒。

The sound of smooth pebbles grinding against each other ceased.
拨弄棋子的声音终于停下。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Has it been seven winters already?
已经7年了吗。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
Yes.
是的。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
I have been your protector for seven years and four months, Left State Councilor. Time passes fast.
自我成为左议政大人的护卫武士起，已经过去7年又4个月了。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Mmh.
嗯。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
May I ask for your opinion? I am certain that your perspective may vary from mine; I was raised in affluence, yet you have clawed your way up from the bottom.
至今为止你所看到的景象如何？从底层走来的你和被温室哺育成长的老夫，目之所及的景色应该大相径庭。

The child began fiddling with the stones again, briefly absorbed in thought. Then he answers with a gentle voice.
那孩子拨弄起棋子，短暂思考后轻声作出了回答。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
The path you walk is a dark and arduous one.
大人要走的是一条幽暗而艰难的路。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
But I believe that you walk that path with unyielding tenacity for the good of this Nest and its feathers.
但我认为，为了这座巢以及巢中的羽，您一定能做出坚决的判断。

The old man knitted his brows. Perhaps the child's answer wasn't what he was looking for.
老人默默蹙起了眉头。似乎是不满意孩子给出的答案。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
You have not once shared your opinion with me, ever since you became my protector.
从始至终你都不愿意表明自己的意见。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
I suppose that is why I am content with you by my side.
可正因如此，老夫才将你留在身边。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
I apologize. My response must not have been to your satisfaction.
十分抱歉。我的回答没能让您满意。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Ha ha, there is no need for apologies.
哈哈，算了。有什么好道歉的。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
... You had the potential to become a <ruby=Cloudblade>Un'geom</ruby> had you served the Right State Councilor instead.
……如果你当初不跟从老夫而是追随右议政，如今或许能成为云剑的候选者。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Is that not the title all those who walk the path of the blade in S Corp. seek? To be recognized as one of the very best in the Nest.
S公司中凡踏入武道一途者，谁人不憧憬这本国第一剑的头衔？

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Not even you would jest that you have never sought one such privilege.
你，不会说什么自己对这些不感兴趣之类的玩笑话吧。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
I am your blade to wield, Left State Councilor. You were the one who chose me.
将我这把剑收入囊中的是左议政大人。

The child responds immediately and indifferently.
那孩子没有丝毫犹豫，坦然回应。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
A blade follows the hand that wields it. And you are that hand, Left State Councilor.
那么，如何处置这把剑全将听凭左议政大人的意愿。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Hah. This is not a move one makes without nary a thought, young man.
哈，这年轻人。怎么都说到这份儿上了还能如此不假思索地做出回答。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
I saw no reason for hesitation.
我认为并不需要犹豫。

The old man—the Left State Councilor—smiled, but there was a tinge of woe in his eyes.
虽然那老人，左议政嘴角似乎高兴地上扬，但目光中却流露出悲伤。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
... If that is your answer, then... I have something to ask of you. Though I hardly deserve to.
你这样说，那老夫可有个不情之请。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
I will do as you command.
请您下令。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Next week... I plan to present this appeal. May I ask you to protect me until then?
下周，老夫想在上诉上赌一把。到那时为止……保护好我这老家伙。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
I fail to see your purpose in asking me to do the duties that I am already intent on performing.
我不理解您为什么将理所当然的事情称作请求。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
... Ah, do you seek to dismiss me after this?
……明白了，在那之后您要罢免我吗。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Ha ha ha! I see that your talent in jests have grown since we first met.
这不是挺会开玩笑的吗！哈哈！

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
... Written in this appeal are the hideous conspiracies, heinous deeds, and studies that have been conducted in secret.
……这之中写的都是关于此地的丑陋秘密、阴险恶行以及研究内容。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Should the contents of my appeal be made public... it will shake S Corp. to its roots.
只要这份内容能传递过去，足以让S公司天翻地覆。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
That is the strength this appeal carries. And such revelatory strength begets those that seek to destroy it. Assassins.
如此有力的内容，必然会比平常招来更多瞄准老夫性命的刺客。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
... Be my blade so that I may see this path to its end. That is my request.
……成为老夫行于路上的利刃，护至最后一刻。这才是请求。

dataList.title:
Protector
护卫武士
dataList.content:
It shall be done.
遵命。

The child replied without a moment of hesitation. He had no reason to.
孩子立即向老人作出回答。因为根本无需踌躇。

Because he never questioned the fact that it was his purpose to protect the Left State Councilor.
对那孩子而言，保护左议政如同呼吸般理所应当。

... And that is why the child could not even imagine that he would ever fail.
……甚至没曾想过自己会失职。

The old man perished, despite the child's vow.
尽管孩子信誓旦旦，老人最后仍未能幸免。

The child's skills with the blade were unparalleled; yet there was only so much that a single person could manage. The powers that be of S Corp. held resources and ploys that no single human could possibly withstand.
即使身怀无人能及的实力，即使如此，那孩子也无法只身凭借手中刀剑与S公司所有掌权者的阴谋诡计抗衡。

No one in S Corp. quite knew who murdered the old man, or how he was murdered. He was killed in a manner that could never be traced.
谁，又是靠何种方式杀害了老人……S公司的人们无从猜测。

But the child knew.
但那孩子知晓。

It was the old man's political enemy... the Right State Councilor's doing.
这是身为老人政敌的右议政所为。

It is before sunbreak; not a soul stirs awake in this hour.
黎明时刻，众人已然沉入梦乡。

There was another old man, sleeping—yet soon awakened by a noise from outside his window.
正在睡梦中的老人被未知的声响惊醒。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
What... I-is there anyone out there?
谁……是谁在哪儿？

The old man peeked open the sliding paper door to his room...
老人缓缓打开发出声音的拉门……

And came face-to-face with the child.
与那孩子四目交汇。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
It was you.
果然是你。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
H-how are you still alive? How did you even get in he—
你、你为什么还活着。你是怎么到这里……

The child was surrounded by corpses of decapitated men.
孩子周围尽是身首异处的人。

He glared at the Right State Councilor with a look of a fiend; there was naught but the silence of dead men who were once his bodyguards.
除了仿佛被附身似的、用饱含邪气的眼神盯着右议政的孩子以外，只剩已经四分五裂的右议政的护卫武士。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
I-if you cut me down, it shall not end with your neck! Your entire family, your entire bloodline shall be purged!
如、如果在这里砍了我，不单单是你，你的家族都将被满门抄斩！

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
The Royal Court will send the Ch'unokkun against you!! Y-you must know how terribly tenacious they are; they will not let the borders of a Nest stop them!
朝廷的推奴人会盯上你们！！谁、谁都知道，哪怕离开了S公司，那些推奴人也会一直穷追不舍！

S Corp., a Wing that places heavy emphasis on tradition and hierarchies, oft sends the Ch'unokkun after contractors who have fled or violated a Taboo.
在严格执行传统和等级制度的S公司，如果受雇之人逃跑或者触犯禁忌，就会派出推奴人去追捕。

Within S Corp., the Fixers might as well be called Ch'unokkun.
在S公司，收尾人也可以被称作推奴人。

And the Ch'unokkun sent by the Royal Court are known to be like the Taboo Hunters of other Wings; they are deadlier and more tenacious than any pursuers.
而且孩子知道，朝廷的推奴人……和其他翼的禁忌猎人相同，比任何人都要危险和难缠。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
I will not cut you down. Your death will change nothing.
我不会斩下去。因为那不会带来任何改变。

The child's voice is terrifyingly cold and collected.
孩子将剑收入鞘中，以冰冷而低沉的声音应答。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Let this be a warning still.
这只是警告。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
A warning that, if I ever find anyone who is capable of tearing these putrid roots from the ground... I will return.
这是在警告你们，如果某日遇见能将这腐败根茎连根拔起的人，我将回归此地。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
A warning that I can easily separate your pathetic head from your body as a blade cuts through weed.
也是在警告，斩下你的首级是多么轻而易举。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
What—?!
什么……！

With that, the child disappeared into the early morning wind.
话音刚落，孩子消失在黎明的空气中。

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
Men!!! Find the best Ch'unokkun in the Nest, now! Arrest anyone who ever had ties to that man!
来人啊！！！现在立刻雇佣最有名的推奴人，把和那家伙有关的人统统抓起来！

dataList.title:
S Corp.
S公司
dataList.content:
I want them hung before me!!!
一定要全抓起来，把他们吊在我面前！！！

The child left the Right State Councilor's echoing bellows behind and resolutely made his way to the borders of S Corp.
远离那些嘈杂声响，孩子向S公司的边界前进。

His persecuted fellows who were barely maintaining their status as feathers at S Corp.
那些在S公司饱受压迫，却依旧担任官职的友人们。

Those who wielded their blades under the banner of the Blade Lineage. He would one day return to this place with them by his side.
以及在S公司内以剑契组之名舞剑的众人，都等待着终有一日，他将率领他们卷土重来。
